description: Team Velobotix is building TerraPulse: an orbital-to-edge Evapotranspiration (ET) calibration system that turns an affordable load cell and Arduino UNO R4 WiFi into a sub-gram micro-lysimeter. By fusing real-time gravimetric plant-soil mass loss (1 g = 1 mL) with NASA POWER, SMAP, and OpenET satellite telemetry, we downscale coarse 9 km satellite pixels into mL-exact irrigation dosing for smallholder farms on Earth and closed-loop Lunar/Martian habitats
